user_story: As a user, I want the forgot-password endpoint to require the email field so that incomplete requests are rejected.

positive.title: Successfully request password reset with valid email
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with a valid email in the required field.
positive.expected_result: The request is accepted, and a confirmation message for password reset is sent to the email.

negative.title: Reject password reset request with missing email field
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint without including the email field.
negative.expected_result: The request is rejected with an error stating that the email field is required.

edge.title: Handle request with empty email field in password reset
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with an empty string as the value of the email field.
edge.expected_result: The request is rejected with an error stating that the email field cannot be empty.
